current_prompt.body:
READ the list L of 45 distinct positive integers
DETERMINE whether L can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for each i in {1, ..., 15}
IF a valid partition exists THEN
OUTPUT one complete example of such a partition
ELSE
OUTPUT that no valid partition exists

current_plan.body:
READ the list L of 45 distinct positive integers
GENERATE all possible triples (a, b, c) from L where a + b = c
SEARCH for a set of 15 disjoint triples that together cover every element of L
IF such a set is found THEN
OUTPUT one complete example of the 15 triples
ELSE
OUTPUT that no valid partition exists
